vaelorian.name: Vaelorian
vaelorian.subtitle: Ash-Born Inheritors
vaelorian.lore: Short-lived, fierce heirs of the shattered Vaelish Empire whose ancestors cracked the First Kiln. Garrisons respect their blood-charters; elder folk remember their hubris.

passive.name: Unbound Will
passive.description: Steadies rolls when wounded, resists fire, and grants one desperate second chance per rest.

vaelorian.worldReactions: Trusted by Iron-Vow garrisons; reads High Vaelish royal seals and invokes Blood-Charters.

ael_thalor.name: Ael-Thalor
ael_thalor.subtitle: Dusk-Woven Exiles
ael_thalor.lore: Ageless, silver-eyed exiles of the Petrified Star-Wood who hear the slow lament of the Pale Root through stone and marrow.

passive.name: Star-Sight
passive.description: Cannot be ambushed; resists cold and resonance; sharpens perception.

ael_thalor.worldReactions: Sings Memory-Canticles to calm beasts and husks, and reads ancient Star-Script.

durnfolk.name: Durnfolk
durnfolk.subtitle: Basalt-Kin
durnfolk.lore: Slate-veined, stone-ribbed smiths and oath-keepers who sealed the lower Kiln-Gates when the abyss breached the deep halls.

passive.name: Stone-Lung
passive.description: Natural stone armor, resists poison and blight, and hones steel at camp.

durnfolk.worldReactions: Opens counterweight dwarf-vaults, stomachs forge-vitriol, and commands deep constructs.

grixi.name: Grixi
grixi.subtitle: Brass-Warren Guild
grixi.lore: Sharp-eared, lantern-eyed citizens of the subterranean Under-Warrens — masters of contract law, black-powder alchemy, and salvage.

passive.name: Scrap-Savant
passive.description: Finds extra coin, resists acid and poison, excels at craft, and unlocks black-market wares.

grixi.worldReactions: Squeezes through narrow vents, cites Under-Cant law, and harvests monster glands.

ashen_blade.name: Ashen Blade
ashen_blade.subtitle: Disgraced Oath-Knight
ashen_blade.lore: You broke a lordly command to save a burning hamlet, and wear scarred steel instead of heraldry.

passive.name: Martial Poise
passive.description: Extra steel edge on melee strikes.

root_scholar.name: Root-Scholar
root_scholar.subtitle: Vesper-Scribe
root_scholar.lore: Expelled from the High Archives for copying forbidden Kiln-liturgies, you read the Pale Root like parchment.

passive.name: Vesper Reservoir
passive.description: Draws ambient focus at the start of every combat round.

barrow_stalker.name: Barrow-Stalker
barrow_stalker.subtitle: Relic-Taker
barrow_stalker.lore: You have guided desperate caravans through spore-fens and plundered kings too dead to object.

passive.name: First Strike
passive.description: Ambushes foes with heightened opening damage.

shrine_penitent.name: Shrine-Penitent
shrine_penitent.subtitle: Bell-Vessel
shrine_penitent.lore: Bound in iron wraps to silence an ancestral curse, you carry the sacred counter-bells against hollowing.

passive.name: Martyr's Endurance
passive.description: Hardened flesh and sacred wards against great horrors.

kiln_lantern.name: Kiln Lantern
kiln_lantern.description: A soot-blackened brass lantern burning a sliver of pre-Shattering ember.
kiln_lantern.combatDescription: Searing kiln-light that breaks guard, restores focus, and lights dark crypts.

orin_bell_shard.name: Orin Bell-Shard
orin_bell_shard.unlockRequirement: Reach Day 7 or slay an Elite foe
orin_bell_shard.description: A bronze splinter cast from the bell that first cracked the Pale Choir.
orin_bell_shard.combatDescription: Counter-harmonic chime that staggers foes and raises armor.

star_dew_vial.name: Star-Dew Vial
star_dew_vial.unlockRequirement: Discover two seals or aid the Silken Cistern
star_dew_vial.description: Moon-distilled sap gathered before the Star-Wood turned to stone.
star_dew_vial.combatDescription: Restores health and resolve, purges afflictions, and blesses rolls.

grixi_chronometer.name: Brass Chronometer
grixi_chronometer.unlockRequirement: Hold 100 Crowns in a run or win a run
grixi_chronometer.description: Ticking brass astrolabe that slips half a heartbeat sideways in time.
grixi_chronometer.combatDescription: Evades the enemy intent completely and strikes back.

kiln_spark.name: Kiln-Spark
kiln_spark.description: Vaelorian cantrip that sears a foe past armor and ignites flesh.

gloam_weave.name: Gloam-Weave
gloam_weave.description: Ael-Thalor cantrip that strikes with twilight resonance and dazes.

anvil_strike.name: Anvil-Strike
anvil_strike.description: Durnfolk crushing blow that shatters guard and staggers the target.

vesper_flask.name: Vesper-Flask
vesper_flask.description: Grixi splash vial that corrodes all enemies with acid mist.

root_snare.name: Root-Snare
root_snare.description: Mutated pale-root claws lash outward, binding and blighting flesh.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Sweeping slashing arc that cuts and bleeds every enemy in reach.

iron_riposte.name: Iron Riposte
iron_riposte.description: Measured counter-cut that raises your guard afterward.

cinder_brand.name: Cinder-Brand
cinder_brand.description: Ember-wreathed blade strike that leaves the target burning.

soul_dart.name: Soul-Dart
soul_dart.description: Unerring resonant bolt that pierces physical armor.

wither_bell.name: Wither-Bell
wither_bell.description: Resonant hex that blights all enemies through stone and mail.

mending_whisper.name: Mending Whisper
mending_whisper.description: Restores health, steadies resolve, and sharpens fortune.

hamstring_shot.name: Hamstring Shot
hamstring_shot.description: Crippling piercing shot that blunts an enemy attack.

heart_seeker.name: Heart-Seeker
heart_seeker.description: Precision strike dealing heavy piercing damage to afflicted foes.

veil_of_ash.name: Veil of Ash
veil_of_ash.description: Cloaks you in drifting ash while restoring stamina and resolve.

chime_of_rebuke.name: Chime Rebuke
chime_of_rebuke.description: Holy counter-ring that shatters guard and staggers all foes.

blood_tithe.name: Blood-Tithe
blood_tithe.description: Spend blood to surge stamina, focus, and resolve.

mercys_seal.name: Mercy's Seal
mercys_seal.description: Mends wounds, restores resolve, and purges afflictions.

iron_stance.name: Iron Stance
iron_stance.description: Hardens might, vitality, and iron poise.

kiln_heart.name: Kiln Strike
kiln_heart.description: Adds fiery force to all attacks and offensive spells.

root_ward.name: Choir Ward
root_ward.description: Thickens defenses, mental focus, and composure.

quick_hands.name: Quick Hands
quick_hands.description: Use pack draughts, poultices, and coatings as a Swift action.

relentless_tempo.name: Relentless Tempo
relentless_tempo.description: Grants one extra Swift action every combat round.
